title: Start Here
type: A new reader’s path through the Codex
dek: Find your bearings through the Ethos, world map, characters, factions, connected histories, and the voices of Fenumion.
sources: Existing public Codex records — editorial reading path; no new lore claims
body:
You do not need to read the entire archive in order. Follow this short path, then choose a person, place, or question that interests you. Mark steps as read to keep your place on this device.

01

Begin with the Ethos

Learn how Fenumion treats its people, consequences, and recovered evidence.

Read the Ethos of Fenumion →
02

Find your bearings

Open the world atlas, choose an island, then select a marker to explore a place.

Explore the world atlas →
03

Meet a few people

Start with the ordinary lives that make the world worth saving. A character’s art, quotes, and relationships offer different ways into their history.

Meet DaleMeet Melian StarguardBrowse the character directory →
04

Follow a shared purpose

Explore the Ale-Chemy Knights and the Veilguard. Their interaction maps show the people, resources, and responsibilities behind each group.

The Ale-Chemy KnightsThe Veilguard
05

Follow one place through time

Try Melian’s House: select its Pristinia map marker, read the location history, and open its dated events to follow the people involved.

Open the Pristinia mapRead Melian’s HouseExplore the Living Timeline →
06

Listen to the world’s voices

Read the memorable quotes, play the available recordings, and explore the community’s character artwork. Use search filters whenever you want to follow a particular person or place.

Read and hear memorable quotesExplore Ececilia’s art →
